independent_units: Complete date:dish units, retaining cells, repeated recordings and repeated sweeps; source filename identifies a recording, not necessarily a distinct cell.
limitations: Curator-only: registered source acquisitions include historical responses; discovery workers must not receive the source root
No test targets exported and no evaluator vault accessed
Reconstruction parity does not establish scientific admission, independent evidence or redistribution rights

partition_provenance.allocation: Original final-date confirmation groups retained; development groups sorted by canonical SHA256([compact-v2, case, opaque group]); first max(2, floor(n/5)) become dev. Registered source identities, not numeric folder matching.

policy.calibration: All <=10 pA sweeps in the same recording, manually approved y and strictly preceding every selected higher-current sweep; mean and last count only
policy.response: Every >10 pA sweep with author quality y, preserving source lineage; no filtering on count magnitude
policy.scope: Conditional prediction of author-derived counts, not independently decoded voltage recordings or causal mechanism
policy.split: Original final acquisition date retained for test; two full development dishes selected by compact-v2 hash rule

reference_parser_provenance.reuse: Measurement and identity specification reimplemented; no upstream fitting, reference state, scientific formula or evaluator copied

units_evidence.basis: Stiffness 0.1kPa/10kPa encoded in CSV values; pA for applied current is inherited from the historical contract and still requires source protocol review.
